# Gcore Developer Tools

> REST API, SDKs, MCP Server, Terraform.


## REST API
- [Gcore REST API](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/overview.md): Gcore REST overview covers authentication, base URLs, and a step-by-step learning path for all Gcore products.
- [API basics](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/api-basics.md): Gcore HTTP request basics cover choosing tools like curl, JSON responses, environment variables, and HTTP status codes.
- [Authenticate to the Gcore API](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/authentication.md): Create a Gcore token, set it as an environment variable, and verify it to authenticate requests.
- [Make the first Gcore API call](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/first-api-call.md): Set up a token, project ID, and region to make the first Gcore Cloud resource call.
- [Asynchronous operations and task polling](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/async-operations.md): Gcore Cloud write operations return a task ID immediately. Poll the task until its state is FINISHED, then read created resource IDs.
- [Error handling](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/error-handling.md): Gcore error handling explains response structure, common error types, status codes, and retry strategy for failed requests.
- [Pagination](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/pagination.md): Gcore list endpoints return paginated results using limit and offset, with count and results fields to iterate through all pages.
- [API tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/rest-api/tools.md): Use Postman, HTTPie, and VS Code REST Client to call Gcore Cloud endpoints.

## SDKs
- [Gcore API SDKs](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/overview.md): Official Gcore SDKs for Python and Go, plus JavaScript fetch and axios options, with async task polling guidance.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/python.md): Use the Gcore Python SDK to install, initialize clients, make calls, paginate, handle errors, retries, timeouts, and async requests.
- [Go SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/sdks/go.md): Use the Gcore Go SDK to make typed REST calls, initialize the client, poll tasks, paginate results, and handle errors and retries.

## MCP Server
- [Gcore MCP Server overview](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/gcore-mcp-server-overview.md): Gcore MCP Server lets AI assistants manage Gcore services with natural language requests and supports setup, clients, and permissions.
- [Install and configure Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/install-and-configure-gcore-mcp-server.md): Install and configure Gcore MCP Server with prerequisites, environment variables, and Cloud defaults for AI clients.
- [Connect Cursor IDE to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-cursor-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Connect Cursor IDE to Gcore MCP Server, configure tool patterns, verify the connection, and test queries.
- [Connect Claude Code to Gcore MCP Server](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/connect-claude-code-to-gcore-mcp-server.md): Set up Claude Code with Gcore MCP Server, authenticate, configure the server, and verify the connection.
- [Available products and tools](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/gcore-mcp-server-available-products-and-tools.md): Gcore MCP Server products and tools cover CDN, cloud, storage, networking, security, DNS, FastEdge, IAM, and streaming.
- [Filter tools with GCORE_TOOLS](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/filter-tools-with-gcore-tools.md): Control which tools the Gcore MCP Server exposes with the GCORE_TOOLS environment variable using toolsets, wildcards, and exact names.
- [Explore and debug tools with MCP Inspector](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/mcp-server/test-tools-with-mcp-inspector.md): Explore and debug Gcore MCP Server tools with MCP Inspector, connecting over stdio or HTTP to test tool schemas and execution errors.

## Terraform
- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/overview.md): Gcore provider overview covers configuration and managing cloud and CDN resources with version-controlled infrastructure code.
- [Get started with Terraform](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/get-started-with-terraform.md): Set up Gcore infrastructure as code with the Gcore provider, from installation to applying configuration.
- [Manage a Terraform project](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/use-variables-and-organize-a-terraform-project.md): Manage an infrastructure as code project with input variables, sensitive values, and tfvars files for each deployment stage.
- [Import existing Gcore infrastructure into Terraform](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/import-existing-gcore-infrastructure-into-terraform.md): Bring existing Gcore resources under infrastructure as code management by importing them into state files with resource types and IDs.
- [Migrate from Gcore Terraform provider v0 to v2](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/migrate-v0-to-v2.md): Steps to migrate the Gcore provider from v0 to v2, covering resource renames, attribute changes, and manual re-import.
- [Copy resources across environments](https://docs.gcore.com/developer-tools/terraform/copy-resources-across-environments.md): Copy resources across environments using variables and workspaces to keep preproduction and production configurations identical.
